methods.get_head: fresh nonce-bound authenticated head and current generation
methods.get_committed: idempotency lookup returns exact bytes/status or unknown; no inferred success
methods.reserve: CAS expected generation/head and transactional capacity; committed exact attempt/binding
methods.release: authenticated terminal/output/archive/cleanup evidence; atomic descendant/frontier transition
methods.rebuild_projection: replay from independently anchored committed prefix; no authority from projection

unknown_behavior: stop new launches; retain active reservation and exact evidence; no automatic retry/cleanup assumption
